column1: # PagerOS partition layout for ESP32-S3 N16R8 (16 MB flash).
# Implements SPEC §13.2: A/B firmware slots with rollback + recovery image.
# The inactive OTA slot doubles as the OTA download staging area (standard ESP-IDF flow).
#   otadata           0x0F000  -   8 KB  active-slot pointer + rollback bits
#   factory (recovery) 0x20000 - 1.5 MB  unbrickable recovery image (boot fallback)
#   ota_0 (slot A)   0x1A0000  -   5 MB  application slot A
#   ota_1 (slot B)   0x6A0000  -   5 MB  application slot B (also OTA staging)
